bridge_line: The Egyptian who went into the desert, and drew others after him.
The founder of the shared life: monks living together under one rule.
Pachomius's brother, remembered as the first to join him.
An elder at Scetis, remembered for refusing to judge another man's fault.
An elder remembered for the word that sent him away: flee, be silent, be still.
One of the desert mothers. Her answer to the elders is our clearest woman's voice.
A desert mother our tradition names. We carry no saying of hers.
